Command: cd /var/log
Category: Navigation
Description: Changes the current directory to /var/log.
Example Output: [No output, changes directory]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cd.1.html

Command: pwd
Category: Navigation
Description: Prints the current working directory.
Example Output: /home/user
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/pwd.1.html

Command: ls -la
Category: Navigation
Description: Lists all files (including hidden) in long format.
Example Output: drwxr-xr-x 2 user user 4096 May 21 2025 file.txt
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ls.1.html

Command: cp file.txt /backup
Category: File Management
Description: Copies file.txt to the /backup directory.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cp.1.html

Command: mv oldname.txt newname.txt
Category: File Management
Description: Renames or moves oldname.txt to newname.txt.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/mv.1.html

Command: rm -rf directory
Category: File Management
Description: Recursively deletes directory and its contents.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/rm.1.html

Command: touch newfile.txt
Category: File Management
Description: Creates an empty file named newfile.txt or updates its timestamp.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/touch.1.html

Command: mkdir -p /path/to/newdir
Category: File Management
Description: Creates directory newdir with parent directories as needed.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/mkdir.1.html

Command: cat logfile.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays the contents of logfile.txt.
Example Output: Log entry: 2025-05-21 11:02:00
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cat.1.html

Command: less largefile.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Views largefile.txt with pagination.
Example Output: [Interactive display of file content]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/less.1.html

Command: head -n 5 access.log
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays the first 5 lines of access.log.
Example Output: [First 5 lines of file]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/head.1.html

Command: tail -n 10 error.log
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays the last 10 lines of error.log.
Example Output: [Last 10 lines of file]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/tail.1.html

Command: uname -a
Category: System Info
Description: Displays all system information (kernel, hostname, etc.).
Example Output: Linux host 5.15.0-73-generic #80-Ubuntu SMP
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/uname.1.html

Command: top
Category: System Info
Description: Displays real-time system processes and resource usage.
Example Output: [Interactive process monitor]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/top.1.html

Command: df -h
Category: System Info
Description: Shows disk usage in human-readable format.
Example Output: Filesystem Size Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/sda1 100G 50G 50G 50% /
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/df.1.html

Command: free -m
Category: System Info
Description: Displays memory usage in megabytes.
Example Output: total used free shared buff/cache available
Mem: 8192 4096 2048 512 2048 4096
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/free.1.html

Command: chmod 755 script.sh
Category: Permissions
Description: Sets script.sh to executable for all, readable/writable for owner.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/chmod.1.html

Command: chown user:group file.txt
Category: Permissions
Description: Changes ownership of file.txt to user and group.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/chown.1.html

Command: apt update
Category: Package Management
Description: Updates package lists for upgrades on Debian-based systems.
Example Output: Hit:1 http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu focal InRelease
Reading package lists... Done
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/apt.8.html

Command: apt install nginx
Category: Package Management
Description: Installs the nginx web server on Debian-based systems.
Example Output: Reading package lists... Done
Building dependency tree
Setting up nginx (1.18.0-6ubuntu14)...
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/apt.8.html

Command: yum update
Category: Package Management
Description: Updates package lists for upgrades on CentOS/RHEL systems.
Example Output: Loaded plugins: fastestmirror
Determining fastest mirrors
No packages marked for update
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/yum.8.html

Command: dnf install python3
Category: Package Management
Description: Installs Python 3 on Fedora-based systems.
Example Output: Installing: python3-3.9.6-2.fc34.x86_64
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/dnf.8.html

Command: ping -c 4 google.com
Category: Networking
Description: Sends 4 ICMP echo requests to google.com to check connectivity.
Example Output: 4 packets transmitted, 4 received, 0% packet loss, time 3004ms
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/ping.8.html

Command: ifconfig
Category: Networking
Description: Displays network interface configuration.
Example Output: eth0: flags=4163<UP,BROADCAST,RUNNING,MULTICAST> mtu 1500
inet 192.168.1.100
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/ifconfig.8.html

Command: netstat -tulpn
Category: Networking
Description: Lists listening ports and associated processes.
Example Output: tcp 0 0 0.0.0.0:22 0.0.0.0:* LISTEN 1234/sshd
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/netstat.8.html

Command: whoami
Category: User Management
Description: Displays the current user's username.
Example Output: user
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/whoami.1.html

Command: id
Category: User Management
Description: Shows user and group IDs for the current user.
Example Output: uid=1000(user) gid=1000(user) groups=1000(user),4(adm),27(sudo)
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/id.1.html

Command: adduser newuser
Category: User Management
Description: Interactively adds a new user to the system.
Example Output: Adding user `newuser' ...
Enter new UNIX password:
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/adduser.8.html

Command: ps aux
Category: Process
Description: Lists all running processes with detailed information.
Example Output: user 1234 0.1 0.2 123456 7890 ? S 11:02 0:00 /usr/bin/python3
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ps.1.html

Command: kill -9 1234
Category: Process
Description: Forcefully terminates the process with PID 1234.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/kill.1.html

Command: htop
Category: Process
Description: Interactive process viewer with enhanced UI.
Example Output: [Interactive process monitor]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/htop.1.html

Command: vim file.txt
Category: Editor
Description: Opens file.txt in the Vim text editor.
Example Output: [Interactive editor interface]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/vim.1.html

Command: nano config.conf
Category: Editor
Description: Opens config.conf in the Nano text editor.
Example Output: [Interactive editor interface]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/nano.1.html

Command: cd ~
Category: Navigation
Description: Changes to the current user's home directory.
Example Output: [No output, changes directory]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cd.1.html

Command: ls -R
Category: Navigation
Description: Recursively lists all files and subdirectories.
Example Output: ./subdir:
file1.txt file2.txt
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ls.1.html

Command: cp -r dir1 dir2
Category: File Management
Description: Recursively copies dir1 to dir2.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cp.1.html

Command: mv dir1 /archive
Category: File Management
Description: Moves dir1 to the /archive directory.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/mv.1.html

Command: rm file.txt
Category: File Management
Description: Deletes file.txt.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/rm.1.html

Command: cat file1.txt file2.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Concatenates and displays contents of file1.txt and file2.txt.
Example Output: Content of file1
Content of file2
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cat.1.html

Command: less -N logfile.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Views logfile.txt with line numbers.
Example Output: [Interactive display with line numbers]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/less.1.html

Command: head access.log
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays the first 10 lines of access.log.
Example Output: [First 10 lines of file]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/head.1.html

Command: tail -f error.log
Category: Viewing
Description: Monitors error.log in real-time.
Example Output: [Live updates of new lines]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/tail.1.html

Command: uname -r
Category: System Info
Description: Displays the kernel release version.
Example Output: 5.15.0-73-generic
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/uname.1.html

Command: df /
Category: System Info
Description: Shows disk usage for the root filesystem.
Example Output: Filesystem 1K-blocks Used Available Use% Mounted on
/dev/sda1 104857600 52428800 52428800 50% /
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/df.1.html

Command: free -h
Category: System Info
Description: Displays memory usage in human-readable format.
Example Output: total used free shared buff/cache available
Mem: 8.0G 4.0G 2.0G 512M 2.0G 4.0G
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/free.1.html

Command: chmod +x script.sh
Category: Permissions
Description: Makes script.sh executable by adding execute permission.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/chmod.1.html

Command: chown -R user:group /data
Category: Permissions
Description: Recursively changes ownership of /data to user and group.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/chown.1.html

Command: apt upgrade
Category: Package Management
Description: Upgrades installed packages to their latest versions on Debian-based systems.
Example Output: Reading package lists... Done
0 upgraded, 0 newly installed, 0 to remove
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/apt.8.html

Command: yum install httpd
Category: Package Management
Description: Installs the Apache web server on CentOS/RHEL systems.
Example Output: Installing: httpd-2.4.46-1.el8.x86_64
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/yum.8.html

Command: dnf update
Category: Package Management
Description: Updates package lists and upgrades packages on Fedora-based systems.
Example Output: Last metadata expiration check: 0:00:01 ago
No packages marked for update
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/dnf.8.html

Command: ping 8.8.8.8
Category: Networking
Description: Sends ICMP echo requests to Google's public DNS server.
Example Output: 64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=1 ttl=117 time=20.0 ms
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/ping.8.html

Command: ifconfig eth0
Category: Networking
Description: Displays configuration for the eth0 network interface.
Example Output: eth0: flags=4163<UP,BROADCAST,RUNNING,MULTICAST> mtu 1500
inet 192.168.1.100
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/ifconfig.8.html

Command: netstat -an
Category: Networking
Description: Lists all active network connections and ports.
Example Output: tcp 0 0 0.0.0.0:22 0.0.0.0:* LISTEN
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/netstat.8.html

Command: whoami
Category: User Management
Description: Displays the current user's username.
Example Output: user
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/whoami.1.html

Command: id newuser
Category: User Management
Description: Shows user and group IDs for newuser.
Example Output: uid=1001(newuser) gid=1001(newuser) groups=1001(newuser)
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/id.1.html

Command: adduser --home /home/testuser testuser
Category: User Management
Description: Adds testuser with a specified home directory.
Example Output: Adding user `testuser' ...
Enter new UNIX password:
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/adduser.8.html

Command: ps -ef
Category: Process
Description: Lists all processes with full details.
Example Output: uid 1234 user 0.0 0.1 123456 7890 ? S 11:02 0:00 /usr/bin/python3
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ps.1.html

Command: kill 1234
Category: Process
Description: Terminates the process with PID 1234 gracefully.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/kill.1.html

Command: htop -u user
Category: Process
Description: Shows processes for a specific user in htop.
Example Output: [Interactive process monitor for user]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/htop.1.html

Command: vim +10 file.txt
Category: Editor
Description: Opens file.txt in Vim at line 10.
Example Output: [Interactive editor interface]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/vim.1.html

Command: nano -l config.conf
Category: Editor
Description: Opens config.conf in Nano with line numbers.
Example Output: [Interactive editor interface with line numbers]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/nano.1.html

Command: cd ..
Category: Navigation
Description: Moves up one directory level.
Example Output: [No output, changes directory]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cd.1.html

Command: ls -lh
Category: Navigation
Description: Lists files in long format with human-readable sizes.
Example Output: -rw-r--r-- 1 user user 1.2M May 21 2025 file.txt
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ls.1.html

Command: cp file.txt file.bak
Category: File Management
Description: Creates a backup copy of file.txt as file.bak.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cp.1.html

Command: mv file.txt /tmp
Category: File Management
Description: Moves file.txt to the /tmp directory.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/mv.1.html

Command: rm -i file.txt
Category: File Management
Description: Deletes file.txt with interactive confirmation.
Example Output: rm: remove regular file 'file.txt'? y
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/rm.1.html

Command: cat -n script.sh
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays script.sh with line numbers.
Example Output: 1 #!/bin/bash
2 echo 'Hello, World!'
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cat.1.html

Command: less +G logfile.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Opens logfile.txt in less, starting at the end.
Example Output: [Interactive display from end]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/less.1.html

Command: head -n 20 access.log
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays the first 20 lines of access.log.
Example Output: [First 20 lines of file]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/head.1.html

Command: tail -n +2 error.log
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays error.log starting from the second line.
Example Output: [All lines except the first]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/tail.1.html

Command: cd -
Category: Navigation
Description: Returns to the previous directory.
Example Output: [No output, changes to previous directory]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cd.1.html

Command: ls -t
Category: Navigation
Description: Lists files sorted by modification time, newest first.
Example Output: file1.txt file2.txt
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ls.1.html

Command: pwd -P
Category: Navigation
Description: Prints the physical current directory, resolving symlinks.
Example Output: /home/user/realpath
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/pwd.1.html

Command: cp -p file.txt /backup
Category: File Management
Description: Copies file.txt to /backup, preserving timestamps and permissions.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cp.1.html

Command: mv -i file.txt /tmp
Category: File Management
Description: Moves file.txt to /tmp with interactive prompt for overwrite.
Example Output: mv: overwrite '/tmp/file.txt'? y
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/mv.1.html

Command: rm -r dir1
Category: File Management
Description: Recursively deletes dir1 and its contents.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/rm.1.html

Command: touch -t 202505211200 file.txt
Category: File Management
Description: Sets file.txt's timestamp to May 21, 2025, 12:00.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/touch.1.html

Command: mkdir newdir
Category: File Management
Description: Creates a directory named newdir.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/mkdir.1.html

Command: cat > newfile.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Creates or overwrites newfile.txt with input from stdin (Ctrl+D to end).
Example Output: [No output, waits for input]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cat.1.html

Command: less +F logfile.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Monitors logfile.txt in less, similar to tail -f.
Example Output: [Live updates of new lines]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/less.1.html

Command: head -c 100 file.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays the first 100 bytes of file.txt.
Example Output: [First 100 bytes of file]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/head.1.html

Command: tail -n 5 access.log
Category: Viewing
Description: Displays the last 5 lines of access.log.
Example Output: [Last 5 lines of file]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/tail.1.html

Command: uname -m
Category: System Info
Description: Displays the machine hardware architecture.
Example Output: x86_64
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/uname.1.html

Command: top -n 1
Category: System Info
Description: Runs top for one iteration and exits.
Example Output: [Snapshot of process monitor]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/top.1.html

Command: df -T
Category: System Info
Description: Shows disk usage with filesystem types.
Example Output: Filesystem Type 1K-blocks Used Available Use% Mounted on
/dev/sda1 ext4 104857600 52428800 52428800 50% /
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/df.1.html

Command: free -t
Category: System Info
Description: Displays total memory usage, including swap.
Example Output: total used free shared buff/cache available
Mem: 8192 4096 2048 512 2048 4096
Swap: 2048 1024 1024
Total: 10240 5120 3072
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/free.1.html

Command: chmod 644 file.txt
Category: Permissions
Description: Sets file.txt to read/write for owner, read-only for others.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/chmod.1.html

Command: chown -h user symlink
Category: Permissions
Description: Changes ownership of symlink to user without affecting the target.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/chown.1.html

Command: apt autoremove
Category: Package Management
Description: Removes unused dependencies on Debian-based systems.
Example Output: Reading package lists... Done
0 to remove, 0 not upgraded.
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/apt.8.html

Command: apt purge nginx
Category: Package Management
Description: Removes nginx and its configuration files on Debian-based systems.
Example Output: Removing nginx (1.18.0-6ubuntu14)...
Purging configuration files...
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/apt.8.html

Command: yum remove httpd
Category: Package Management
Description: Uninstalls the Apache web server on CentOS/RHEL systems.
Example Output: Removing: httpd-2.4.46-1.el8.x86_64
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/yum.8.html

Command: dnf upgrade
Category: Package Management
Description: Upgrades all packages to the latest versions on Fedora-based systems.
Example Output: Upgrading: python3-3.9.7-1.fc34.x86_64
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/dnf.8.html

Command: ping -i 0.5 google.com
Category: Networking
Description: Sends ICMP echo requests to google.com every 0.5 seconds.
Example Output: 64 bytes from google.com: icmp_seq=1 ttl=117 time=20.0 ms
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/ping.8.html

Command: ifconfig eth0 up
Category: Networking
Description: Enables the eth0 network interface.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/ifconfig.8.html

Command: netstat -i
Category: Networking
Description: Displays network interface statistics.
Example Output: Iface MTU RX-OK RX-ERR RX-DRP RX-OVR TX-OK TX-ERR TX-DRP TX-OVR Flg
eth0 1500 12345 0 0 0 12345 0 0 0 BMRU
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/netstat.8.html

Command: who
Category: User Management
Description: Lists currently logged-in users.
Example Output: user pts/0 2025-05-21 11:02 (192.168.1.100)
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/who.1.html

Command: passwd newuser
Category: User Management
Description: Changes the password for newuser.
Example Output: Enter new UNIX password:
Retype new UNIX password:
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/passwd.1.html

Command: userdel -r testuser
Category: User Management
Description: Deletes testuser and their home directory.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/userdel.8.html

Command: ps -C nginx
Category: Process
Description: Lists processes with the command name nginx.
Example Output: PID TTY TIME CMD
1234 ? 00:00:01 nginx
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ps.1.html

Command: killall nginx
Category: Process
Description: Terminates all nginx processes.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/killall.1.html

Command: htop -d 5
Category: Process
Description: Runs htop with a 0.5-second refresh interval.
Example Output: [Interactive process monitor]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/htop.1.html

Command: vim -R file.txt
Category: Editor
Description: Opens file.txt in Vim in read-only mode.
Example Output: [Interactive editor interface]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/vim.1.html

Command: nano -c config.conf
Category: Editor
Description: Opens config.conf in Nano with constant cursor position display.
Example Output: [Interactive editor interface with cursor position]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/nano.1.html

Command: cd /etc
Category: Navigation
Description: Changes the current directory to /etc.
Example Output: [No output, changes directory]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cd.1.html

Command: ls -1
Category: Navigation
Description: Lists files in a single column.
Example Output: file1.txt
file2.txt
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/ls.1.html

Command: cp -u file.txt /backup
Category: File Management
Description: Copies file.txt to /backup only if newer or missing.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cp.1.html

Command: mv -n file.txt /tmp
Category: File Management
Description: Moves file.txt to /tmp without overwriting existing files.
Example Output: [No output if successful]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/mv.1.html

Command: rm -v file.txt
Category: File Management
Description: Deletes file.txt with verbose output.
Example Output: removed 'file.txt'
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/rm.1.html

Command: cat << EOF > script.sh
Category: Viewing
Description: Creates script.sh with input until 'EOF' is entered.
Example Output: [No output, waits for input]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/cat.1.html

Command: less -i logfile.txt
Category: Viewing
Description: Views logfile.txt in less with case-insensitive search.
Example Output: [Interactive display with search]
Man Reference: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/less.1.html
